replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, I can feel some anxiety when dealing with advanced topics because they require a lot of concentration and memory. But I try to break them down into smaller, manageable parts to reduce the stress.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: In my last year of school, I used an AI tutor for maths. It helped me understand concepts better and provided practice problems. The experience was positive as it made learning more interactive.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, identify the quadratic equation in the form ax^2 + bx + c = 0. Then, calculate the discriminant (b^2 - 4ac). If the discriminant is positive, use the quadratic formula x = [-b ± sqrt(discriminant)] / (2a) to find the roots.

To find stationary points, first take the derivative of f(x), which gives the slope of the function at any point. Set the derivative equal to zero and solve for x. These are the potential stationary points. Then, check if they are maxima or minima by taking the second derivative.
